training_frequency: every two years if still employed, six months after starting their job
required_topics: Definition of human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
Guidance on identifying individuals most at risk for human trafficking
Differences between labor and sex-based trafficking within the lodging, restaurant, or truck stop industry
Role of employees in reporting and responding to instances of human trafficking
law_references: Human Trafficking Recognition Training Law (820 ILCS 95)
risks_or_constraints: Potential fines up to $1,500 per offense if not corrected within 30 days after notification
